name: Greenhorn
tip: Focus on high-yield crops early on like Strawberries, Blueberries, or Cranberries.

name: Cowpoke
tip: Expand your farm with preserved goods like Jelly and Pickles.

name: Homesteader
tip: Invest in Artisan Equipment like Kegs and Casks for Wine production.

name: Millionaire
tip: Starfruit and Ancient Fruit Wine processed in Kegs generate massive income.

name: Legend
tip: Fill the Greenhouse and Ginger Island farm with Ancient Fruit.

name: A Complete Collection
tip: Donate all 53 Minerals and 42 Artifacts to Gunther.

name: A New Friend
description: Reach a 5-heart friendship level with someone
tip: Talk to villagers daily and give loved gifts on their birthdays.

name: Best Friends
description: Reach a 10-heart friendship level with someone
tip: Bouquets are required to reach 9-10 hearts with marriage candidates.

name: The Beloved
description: Reach a 10-heart friendship level with 10 people
tip: Focus on non-dateable villagers first as their hearts don't decay at max rank.

name: Cliques
description: Reach a 5-heart friendship level with 4 people
tip: Attend seasonal festivals to talk to almost everyone in town at once.

name: Singular
description: Reach a 5-heart friendship level with 10 people
tip: Universal Likes such as Coffee, Ice Cream, and Tree Fruit are easy mass gifts.

name: Popular
description: Reach a 5-heart friendship level with 20 people
tip: Keep a chest near the Saloon on Friday nights to gift visiting villagers.

name: Cook
tip: Watch 'The Queen of Sauce' on TV every Sunday for free recipes.

name: Sous Chef
tip: Befriend villagers via mail to receive their unique household recipes.

name: Gourmet Chef
tip: Requires cooking all 80 recipes available across vanilla Stardew Valley.

name: Moving Up
tip: Pay Robin 10,000g and 450 Wood for the first house upgrade (adds Kitchen).

name: Living Large
description: Upgrade your house to the maximum size
tip: Requires the Nursery and Cellar upgrades from Robin.

name: D.I.Y.
tip: Leveling up skills unlocks essential crafting blueprints automatically.

name: Artisan
tip: Purchase extra crafting recipes from Robin, Pierre, and festival shops.

name: Craft Master
tip: Turn on 'Show Advanced Crafting Information' in game settings to track crafted counts.

name: Fisherman
tip: Fish across different seasons, weather conditions, and locations.

name: Ol' Mariner
tip: Use Crab Pots in fresh and salt water to catch ocean/river invertebrates.

name: Master Angler
tip: Requires catching all standard fish, night market fish, and Legendary Fish.

name: Mother Catch
tip: Total quantity catch count across any species.

name: Treasure Trove
tip: Process Geodes at Clint's Blacksmith shop to quickly find minerals.

name: Gofer
tip: Check the bulletin board outside Pierre's store daily.

name: A Big Help
tip: Item delivery quests are usually the easiest and fastest to complete.

name: Polyculture
tip: Requires shipping 15 of each of the 28 primary farm crops.

name: Monoculture
tip: High-yield berries like Cranberries or Blueberries make this trivial.

name: Full Shipment
tip: Complete the 'Items Shipped' collection tab in the player menu.

name: Fector's Challenge
description: Beat 'Journey of the Prairie King' without dying
tip: You can exit the arcade machine after completing a level to save your progress.
